heading_en: Buckets, Risk Weights and Correlations for Delta Risk of Credit Spread Risk on Securitization Products (CTP)
summary_ja: 証券化商品(CTP)に係る信用スプレッド・リスクのデルタ・リスクについて、バケット分類、リスク・ウェイト、リスク・ファクター間及びバケット間の相関係数を定める。
summary_en: Sets the bucket classification, risk weights and the correlation coefficients between risk factors and between buckets for delta risk of credit spread risk on securitization products (CTP).
paragraphs: For delta risk of credit spread risk on securitization products (CTP), risk factors shall be classified as provided below. (i) They shall be classified into sixteen buckets according to the categories of credit quality listed in the middle column and sector listed in the lower column of the following table. {{T:p370t1}}. (ii) The classification of sectors in the preceding item shall be based on classifications generally used in the market and shall satisfy all of the following requirements. (a) Each issuer shall be classified into exactly one bucket number. (b) Where an issuer cannot be classified into an individual sector, it shall be classified into bucket number 16.

The risk weights used for delta risk of credit spread risk on securitization products (CTP) shall be as prescribed in the lower column of the following table according to the category of bucket number listed in the upper column of the same table (meaning the bucket number classified under the preceding paragraph; the same applies below in this Article). In this case, the risk weights for all tenors within each bucket (0.5 years, 1 year, 3 years, 5 years or 10 years) shall be the same. {{T:p371t1}}
The correlation coefficient (ρ_{kl}) between risk factors used for delta risk of credit spread risk on securitization products (CTP) shall be calculated by the following formula. {{F:p372i0}}

In the formula of the preceding paragraph, the values of {{F:p372i1}}, {{F:p372i2}} and {{F:p372i3}} shall be as prescribed in each of the following items according to the following categories of correlation coefficient. (i) {{F:p372i4}}: the value prescribed in (a) or (b) below according to the following cases. (a) Where the name of sensitivity k and the name of sensitivity l are the same: 100%. (b) In cases other than (a): 35%. (ii) {{F:p372i5}}: the value prescribed in (a) or (b) below according to the following cases. (a) Where the tenor of sensitivity k and the tenor of sensitivity l are the same: 100%. (b) In cases other than (a): 65%. (iii) {{F:p372i6}}: the value prescribed in (a) or (b) below according to the following cases. (a) Where sensitivity k and sensitivity l relate to the same curve: 100%. (b) In cases other than (a): 99.0%.
The correlation function (γ_{bc}) between buckets used for delta risk of credit spread risk on securitization products (CTP) shall be calculated by the following formula. {{F:p372i7}}

The values of {{F:p372i8}} and {{F:p372i9}} in the formula of the preceding paragraph shall be as prescribed in each of the following items according to the following categories of correlation coefficient. (i) {{F:p372i10}}: the value prescribed in (a) or (b) below according to the following cases. (a) Where both buckets to be aggregated fall under any of bucket numbers 1 through 15, and the credit qualities corresponding to the bucket numbers differ: 50%. (b) In cases other than (a): 100%. (ii) {{F:p373i0}}: the value prescribed in (a) or (b) below according to the following cases. (a) Where both buckets to be aggregated fall under the same bucket number: 100%. (b) In cases other than (a): the correlation coefficient prescribed according to the combination of bucket numbers in the table in paragraph (8), item (ii)(b) of the preceding Article.
